query: My printer's queue is stuck and print jobs will not clear. VPN VPN VPN VPN VPN

items.title: Clear Print Queue - Guide 1
items.content: Stop the print spooler, clear stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and try printing again.

items.title: Printer is online but jobs stay in queue
items.content:
Problem: Printer is online but jobs stay in queue on Ubuntu. Please help because I need this for work.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Cleared the print queue and reinstalled the approved printer driver.
